about.en: Nodle (NODL) is the token of the Nodle network, a decentralized physical infrastructure network in which smartphones running the Nodle app provide Bluetooth connectivity and content-verification services and earn NODL. Originally issued on Nodle's Polkadot parachain, the token now lives on ZKsync Era at 0xbd4372e44c5ee654dd838304006e1f0f69983154.
